goal: Resolve the delivery exception for ticket {ticket_id}. Check the carrier. For a lost parcel, prefer a replacement when available and refund otherwise. Confirm a delivered parcel or arrange pickup of a held parcel. Close the case using the remedy receipt.
limitations: One observed branch. Alternative routes require independent task handling.
